m.t: Oyeron su sagrada voz, pero no conocen su rostro celestial.
m.e: You heard her holy voice, but may not know the heavenly face.

m.t: Durante años les he prometido una sagrada resurrección.
m.e: For years I've promised them a holy resurrection.

m.t: Y que somos perfectamente capaces de preocuparnos por él sin su sagrada bendición.
m.e: And we're perfectly capable of worrying about him without your holy blessing.

m.t: Mientras esté en mi mano, es el agua sagrada del Ganges.
m.e: As long as it's in my hand... it's the holy water of Ganga.

m.t: El Corán es la escritura sagrada de los musulmanes.
m.e: The Quran is the holy scripture of Muslims.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12029093 by Amastan; English translation #9959410 by Amastan

m.t: Encontré el camino más puro para servir a su sagrada voluntad.
m.e: I found the purest way to serve his sacred will.

m.t: Tú distancia muestra tú honor por mi posición, y por mi sagrada unión.
m.e: Your distance shows your honor for my position as well as my sacred union.

m.t: ¿Por qué traes a una actriz prostituta a una ceremonia tan sagrada?
m.e: Why did you bring an actress whore to a sacred rite of passage?

m.t: Un mal uso de una sagrada arte marcial.
m.e: Serious misuse of a sacred martial art.

m.t: Tan sagrada como lo era Ozma, por sí misma.
m.e: As sacred as Ozma was, herself.

m.t: Ahora es una parte sagrada de esto.
m.e: She's a sacred part of it now.

m.t: Tammy, llevo puesta la ropa interior sagrada.
m.e: Tammy, Tammy, I'm wearing the sacred underwear!

m.t: V, el matrimonio es una institución sagrada.
m.e: V, marriage is a sacred institution.

m.t: Esa espada... es sagrada.
m.e: That sword... it's sacred.

m.t: Sí, exacto. Es una vaca sagrada.
m.e: Yes, exactly, it's a sacred cow.

m.t: Bueno, no importa, porque la noche de película es sagrada.
m.e: Well, it doesn't matter, because movie night is sacred.

m.t: Podría parecer así, pero no la llamarían enfermedad sagrada si no fuera especial.
m.e: It may seem that way, but then they wouldn't call it sacred disease if it wasn't special.

m.t: Incluso la vida humana es sagrada.
m.e: Even human life is sacred.

m.t: La hora de la comida es sagrada.
m.e: Meal time is sacred.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1205836 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1209997 by zzxjoanw

m.t: ¿Crees que la vida es sagrada?
m.e: You believe life is sacred.

m.t: Es nuestra misión sagrada.
m.e: This is our sacred mission.

m.t: Una promesa muy sagrada.
m.e: A very sacred promise indeed.

m.t: Sabio señor de la Palabra Sagrada, buscamos tu consejo.
m.e: Wise Lord of the Sacred Word, we seek your counsel.

m.t: Vale, le llevamos a la Sagrada Cruz.
m.e: Okay, we're taking him to Holy Cross.

m.t: Se lo llevan a la Sagrada Cruz.
m.e: They're taking him to Holy Cross.

m.t: Dana, que ha sido aceptado en La última prueba en la Sagrada Misericordia.
m.e: Dana, you've been accepted into the latest trial at Sacred Mercy.

m.t: Ahora me tienes a mí, así que no te van a molestar más.
m.e: You have me now, so they're not gonna bother you anymore.

m.t: A la mayoría ni siquiera se los puede molestar.
m.e: Most people can't even be bothered, you know?

m.t: ¿Me vas a molestar cada vez que tengas una corazonada?
m.e: So, now, you'll bother me each time you get a hunch?

m.t: Estoy bien, de verdad, no quiero molestar.
m.e: It's fine, honestly. I don't wanna be a bother.

m.t: Tom solo hizo eso para molestar a Mary.
m.e: Tom did that just to annoy Mary.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10044244 by manufrutos; English translation #10043887 by CK

m.t: Si compras la mitad de la ciudad, va a molestar a mucha gente.
m.e: You buy up half the town, you're gonna piss off a lot of people.

m.t: No era mi intención molestar a nadie.
m.e: I didn't mean to upset anyone.

m.t: No quiero molestar a nadie.
m.e: I don't want to upset anyone.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10733271 by megamanenm; English translation #3921157 by CK

m.t: Él ya está muerto, no va a molestar.
m.e: He's already killed so he won't hesitate.

m.t: Haré mi mejor esfuerzo por no molestar tu estudio.
m.e: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1023562 by jayefes65; English translation #1304 by djinni74

m.t: No debe suceder de nuevo, bajo el pretexto de no molestar a algunos padres.
m.e: It should not happen again, under the pretext not to disturb some parents.

m.t: Yo no quería molestar a los pacientes.
m.e: I didn't want to disturb the patients.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8014811 by Seael; English translation #3727609 by CM

m.t: El acosador no nos dejó de molestar.
m.e: The stalker did not stop bothering us.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3276185 by cueyayotl; English translation #12891913 by mexicanhere

m.t: Él no puede dejar de molestar.
m.e: He can't stop messing around.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8678014 by ajje; English translation #8678017 by ajje

m.t: Oye, deja de molestar.
m.e: Hey, stop fooling around.

m.t: Deja de molestar a Tom.
m.e: Stop harassing Tom.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2625323 by Shishir; English translation #2235888 by CK

m.t: Vamos, debe haber algo que él haga que te moleste.
m.e: Come on, there's got to be something he does that irritates you.

m.t: Espero que no te moleste que me haya pasado.
m.e: I hope you don't mind me dropping by.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5692879 by arh; English translation #2360958 by CK

m.t: En serio, ¿hay alguien con quien no te moleste que salga?
m.e: Seriously, is there anybody out there that you're okay with me being with?

m.t: Aunque esto les moleste, tengo un Proceso que dirigir.
m.e: As much as this may bother you, I have a Process to lead.

m.t: Ha pedido que no se la moleste.
m.e: Has asked not to be disturbed.

m.t: Espero no te moleste.
m.e: I hope you don't mind.

m.t: - No la moleste ahora.
m.e: - Don't disturb her now.

m.t: No, no lo moleste, eso sería ridículo.
m.e: No, no, don't disturb him, that would be ridiculous.

m.t: No se moleste en hacer tantos viajes.
m.e: Don't bother making so many trips.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2265828 by carlosalberto; English translation #2265827 by _undertoad

m.t: No se moleste ¿Hay alguno casado aquí?
m.e: There's no need ! Is anyone here married ?

m.t: Ni se moleste en llamarme.
m.e: Don't bother to call me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7932374 by Seael; English translation #29145 by Eldad

m.t: No se moleste, por favor.
m.e: Please, don't trouble yourself.

m.t: - No se moleste con excusas.
m.e: Don't bother with excuses.

m.t: "No me molestes, porque ahora estoy muy fuera de mí".
m.e: "Don't bother me, because I'm too crazy right now."

m.t: No me molestes con preguntas tontas.
m.e: Don't bother me with such foolish questions.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #856262 by Naaa77; English translation #41557 by Swift

m.t: Por favor no me molestes.
m.e: Please don't bother me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5749093 by Firesoul7; English translation #5748956 by CK

m.t: No me molestes sobre eso.
m.e: Don't bother me about that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5199423 by Elyte; English translation #5199093 by AlanF_US

m.t: Te lo dije, no lo molestes.
m.e: I told you, don't annoy it.

m.t: No me molestes cuando estoy estudiando.
m.e: Don't disturb me while I'm studying.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #521193 by Shishir; English translation #251805 by CK

m.t: No la molestes mientras duerme.
m.e: Don't disturb her while she is sleeping.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1838434 by hayastan; English translation #309481 by CH

m.t: Él susurró "No la molestes. Ella está trabajando ahora mismo".
m.e: Don't disturb her. She is at work right now he whispered.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1608011 by teskmon; English translation #73639 by \N

m.t: No molestes a Tom mientras está durmiendo.
m.e: Don't disturb Tom while he's asleep.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10195406 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #9927071 by CK

m.t: No es que me molestes, no lo tomes mal.
m.e: It's not that you're disturbing me, don't get it wrong.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3067947 by estambulista; English translation #3067948 by estambulista

m.t: No te molestes en venir a mi casa.
m.e: Do not bother to come to my home.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3867122 by cueyayotl; English translation #29153 by Dejo

m.t: Con tan pocos de ustedes ni siquiera te molestes.
m.e: With so few of you, don't even bother.

m.t: Ni te molestes, él va a ganar de todas formas.
m.e: Don't even bother, he'll win anyway.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1570140 by marcelostockle; English translation #848914 by Vulgaris

m.t: No te molestes en contestar esta carta.
m.e: Don't bother to answer this letter.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1271693 by wallebot; English translation #58671 by CK

m.t: No te molestes en buscar el lugar.
m.e: Don't bother looking for the place now.

m.t: Entonces no te molestes en regresar aquí.
m.e: Then don't bother to come back here at all.

m.t: ¡No te molestes, ella ya me descubrió!
m.e: Don't bother, she's caught me!

m.t: No te molestes en recogerme del hotel.
m.e: Don't bother to pick me up at the hotel.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2654303 by Espi; English translation #29154 by CK

m.t: No te molestes en hacer eso.
m.e: Don't bother doing that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6842375 by arh; English translation #6841622 by CK

m.t: Por favor, no te molestes por mí.
m.e: Please, don't bother on my behalf.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1243054 by marcelostockle; English translation #7918387 by fpp

m.t: No te molestes en llamarme.
m.e: Don't bother to call me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7932370 by Seael; English translation #29145 by Eldad

m.t: No te molestes en discutirlo. Los humanos son impermeables a la lógica.
m.e: Don't bother arguing with it; humans are impervious to logic.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10712097 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #6589385 by mailohilohi

m.t: - No te molestes, cariño.
m.e: - Don't bother, sweetheart.

m.t: ¿Solo viniste a molestarme o quizá había otra razón?
m.e: So you just come down here to give me shit, or was there maybe another reason?

m.t: Pero haces un montón de dinero, así que deja de molestarme al respecto .
m.e: But you make plenty of money, so stop bugging me about it.

m.t: Sí, no le gusta molestarme cuando estoy trabajando.
m.e: Yeah, he doesn't like to bother me when I'm working.

m.t: De verdad, no pensé que tu trabajo pudiese molestarme, pero supongo que así fue.
m.e: Honestly, I-I didn't think your job would bother me, but I guess it did.

m.t: Supongo que estás aquí por algún otro motivo más que para molestarme, ¿verdad?
m.e: I take it you're here for some other reason than to annoy me, right?

m.t: Solía molestarme... lo difícil que era contactar contigo.
m.e: It used to annoy me... how difficult it was to reach you.

m.t: Por favor vete y deja de molestarme.
m.e: Please go away and stop annoying me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #727891 by Fanki; English translation #71710 by CK

m.t: Porque si tengo que decirlo, realmente va a molestarme.
m.e: Because if I have to say it, it's gonna really upset me.

m.t: Parece que lo haces para molestarme.
m.e: It seems like you're doing it to make me upset.

m.t: ¡Dejen de molestarme y busquen al psicópata que voló a mi pandilla!
m.e: Why don't you stop hassling' me and go after the psycho who blew away my crew!

m.t: A tu hijo le encanta molestarme.
m.e: Your son loves bugging me.

m.t: Y después de salir de la cárcel, él empezó a molestarme por dinero
m.e: And after he got out of prison, He started pestering me for money.

m.t: Mira. A tus amigos y a ti les encanta molestarme.
m.e: Look, you and your friends just like to fuck with me.

m.t: ¿Podrías dejar de molestarme?
m.e: Will you please stop dousing me?

m.t: Ya no quiero molestarme en dar explicaciones.
m.e: I don't even want to bother explaining.

m.t: Si alguien la estaba molestando, me lo habría dicho.
m.e: If someone was bothering her, she would've told me.

m.t: ¿No deberías estar por ahí molestando en alguna parte?
m.e: Shouldn't you be out screwing up somewhere?

m.t: La otra oficina es sólo para mostrar a cualquiera que nos esté molestando.
m.e: The other office is just for show for anybody who's pestering us.

m.t: Esos tíos me están molestando de verdad.
m.e: These guys are really pissing me off.

m.t: Tu voz también me está molestando a mí.
m.e: Your voice is annoying me, too.

m.t: «¿Por qué no me puede dejar tranquila Tom?» «¡Dile que te está molestando!»
m.e: Why can't Tom leave me alone? "Tell him he's annoying you!"
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10024618 by Shishir; English translation #10025337 by espamatics

m.t: No te estamos molestando, espero.
m.e: We're not disturbing you, I hope.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4375541 by pchamorro; English translation #3310904 by CK

m.t: ¿Les estoy molestando a ustedes?
m.e: Am I disturbing you?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3285275 by Kary; English translation #1886371 by CK

m.t: Me preguntaba por qué las chicas te estaban molestando.
m.e: I was wondering why the girls were picking on you.

m.t: ¿Por qué estás molestando a tu hermana?
m.e: Why are you annoying your sister?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12903355 by entusiasta; English translation #1776697 by Amastan

m.t: ¿Te han estado molestando mis niños?
m.e: Have my kids been annoying you?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3150910 by marcelostockle; English translation #1879882 by CK

m.t: Por favor, ¿por qué la estáis molestando?
m.e: Please, why are you hassling her?

m.t: Estás molestando a los vecinos.
m.e: You're disturbing the neighbors.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9192198 by hayastan; English translation #9192168 by bill

m.t: Estamos molestando a la maestra.
m.e: We're annoying the teacher.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12847773 by mexicanhere; English translation #8078723 by CK

m.t: La noche que se iba para su último vuelo Seguí molestando ella en varias ocasiones.
m.e: The night she was leaving for her last flight I kept nagging her repeatedly.

m.t: Tom me ha estado molestando desde hace meses.
m.e: Tom has been bullying me for months.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3959678 by senryakun; English translation #3956428 by CK

m.t: Estamos molestando a Tom porque él siempre nos molesta.
m.e: We are disturbing Tom because he always disturbs us.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1701745 by marcelostockle; English translation #1700611 by Amastan

m.t: Estás molestando a Tom.
m.e: You're upsetting Tom.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2469283 by arnxy20; English translation #2218471 by CK

m.t: Me mataría por decirte, pero siempre le ha molestado.
m.e: She'd kill me for telling you, but it's always bothered her.

m.t: Hay al menos dos cosas que me habrían molestado.
m.e: There were at least two things that would've bothered me.

m.t: Bueno, desde luego he molestado a bastantes personas en mi tiempo.
m.e: Well, I've certainly pissed off a lot of people in my day.

m.t: ¿Se ha molestado en contratar a alguien que pueda navegar esa cosa?
m.e: Has he bothered to employ anyone who can actually sail that thing?

m.t: Si te he molestado de alguna manera, lo siento.
m.e: If I've upset you in any way, I'm sorry.

m.t: Siento cualquier cosa que haya hecho que te haya molestado.
m.e: I'm sorry for whatever I did that upset you.

m.t: Todavía no sé que he hecho para que se haya molestado .
m.e: I still don't know what I did to upset you.

m.t: Papá, siento si te he molestado.
m.e: Dad, I'm sorry if I upset you.

m.t: - ¿Qué, ahora te he molestado?
m.e: - What, now I've upset you?

m.t: Te pido disculpas si mi presencia aquí te ha molestado.
m.e: I apologize if my coming here disturbed you.

m.t: Lo siento. ¿La traición de mi terapeuta ha molestado tu, de otro modo, día tranquilo?
m.e: Oh, I'm sorry. Has my therapist's betrayal inconvenienced your otherwise tranquil day?

m.t: No voy a ser molestado.
m.e: I'm not to be disturbed.

m.t: Y él dijo: "Unos niños en el colegio me están molestado".
m.e: And he said, "There are boys at school that are bullying me."

m.t: No puedo soportar ser molestado en el trabajo.
m.e: I can't stand being disturbed in my work.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #866201 by Tux; English translation #245354 by CK

m.t: A Tom no le gusta ser molestado.
m.e: Tom doesn't like to be disturbed.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1439767 by marcelostockle; English translation #1026014 by CK

m.t: En ese caso, me alegra que te hayas molestado.
m.e: In that case, I'm glad you bothered.

m.t: No sé ni por qué cojones me he molestado en venir.
m.e: I don't know why I bothered coming here.

m.t: Desayuno en familia y nadie se ha molestado en invitar al padre.
m.e: Family breakfast, no one bothers to invite the padre.

m.t: Tú nunca, ni una sola vez, te has molestado en compartir esas razones conmigo.
m.e: You never once, not once, bothered to share those reasons with me.

m.t: ¿Así que no te has molestado en subir a la lectura del libro de mi hijo?
m.e: So you couldn't bother to turn up to my son's book reading?

m.t: Oye, ¿te molestaría que ponga algo de música?
m.e: Hey, man, do you mind if I put some tunes on?

m.t: ¿Te molestaría si te dijera que he creado un negocio con mi ex?
m.e: Would it bother you if I told you that I started a business with my ex?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2960066 by alekso; English translation #4022876 by eeyinn

m.t: ¿Os molestaría si hiciera algún comentario fuera de lugar?
m.e: Is it gonna bug you guys if I do some off-kilter commentary?

m.t: No sabía que te molestaría tanto.
m.e: I didn't know you'd be this upset.

m.t: ¿Por qué se molestaría en ayudar a un vago como tú?
m.e: Why would she go out of her way to help a deadbeat like you?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #885201 by darinmex; English translation #885200 by darinmex

m.t: Yo no me molestaría.
m.e: Oh, I wouldn't bother.

m.t: No quiero molestarla, esperaba poder charlar con usted.
m.e: I don't mean to bother you, I was hoping to talk to you.

m.t: ¿Podría... podría molestarla con un poco más de café?
m.e: Could I, um, could I trouble you for some more coffee?

m.t: Siento molestarla pero estamos investigando un incidente en el barrio.
m.e: Sorry to bother you, but we're investigating an incident in the neighborhood.

m.t: Lo que hizo para molestarla, fue un gran error.
m.e: Whatever you did to upset her, it was a big mistake.

m.t: Desde luego que no quería molestarla.
m.e: Of course I didn't want to upset her.

m.t: No estamos tratando de molestarla.
m.e: We're not trying to upset her.

m.t: "Significaba que tenía visita y yo no debía molestarla."
m.e: It meant she had a visitor and I wasn't to disturb her.

m.t: Sentimos molestarla en lo que debe ser un momento muy difícil.
m.e: We're sorry to disturb you at what must be a very difficult time.

m.t: Voy a estar entrando y saliendo, no voy a molestarla.
m.e: I'll be in and out, I won't disturb her.

m.t: Creo que el personal no quería molestarla.
m.e: I think the staff didn't want to disturb you.

m.t: No quería molestarla en su casa.
m.e: I didn't want to disturb you at home.

m.t: - No quería molestarla pero llamó un hombre del Banco Aliado Islamorada.
m.e: - I didn't wanna disturb you, but a man from the Islamorada Allied Bank called.

m.t: Señora, lo siento por molestarla.
m.e: - Ma'am, I'm sorry to trouble you.

m.t: Voy a molestarla esta noche.
m.e: I'm gonna butter her up tonight.
